{{Top|leg}}
'''Disruptor torpedoes''' were torpedoes which carried a powerful ion capacitor that discharged on impact, similar to an [[Ion bomb/Legends|ion bomb]]. The energy produced by a single torpedo impact could completely disable a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] sized vessel, or disable systems near the impact zone when targeting at capital ships.

These [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] were commonly used by the [[I4 Ionizer starfighter]].
